title: Kaniadakis Holographic Dark Energy (κ-entropy generalisation)
efc_relevance: Replaces Boltzmann–Gibbs entropy with Kaniadakis κ-entropy in the holographic DE construction. Same information-entropy family as EFC but with a different functional form for the entropy functional S[ρ]. Discriminator is the late-time growth-rate fingerprint fσ8(z) and the sign of the deviation at the matter–DE crossover.
ledger_action: Logged as Kaniadakis-variant cousin of HDE. Required comparison in WP1 recovery-conditions table (κ→0 should recover EFC entropic term).
